verdict.rationale: Robot bring-up is a fair question for a robotics simulator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only building blocks: custom plugins, SDF snippets from Fuel, example worlds, the ros_gz install and PID controller utilities. Nothing documents a product capability or workflow for bringing up a new robot's drivers, configuration and first motion in hours rather than weeks.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can bring up a new robot — drivers, configuration, first motion — in hours rather than weeks
